content: Anything interesting in the paper today, dear?
Well, yeah! There are a few here that might interest us. Here's one for just $400. It only has one bedroom but it sounds nice, near Lake Street.
Yeah. Let me see what the cheapest two-bedroom apartment is. Oh, here's one on Market Street. It's a real bargain, only $350. But it doesn't have any furniture.
Well, it costs a lot to buy all the furniture.
Oh, here's another one for just over $400. This sounds very interesting. It's on South Street, that's a nice area!
Yes, it's quiet. Did you say 2 bedrooms?
Why don't we go and have a look?
OK, I'll give them a call.
